correctness.rationale: Enumerating all disjoint subsets of the 32 undirected cube edges yields exactly 41,025 faces including the empty face, with cardinality vector (1,32,400,2496,8256,14208,11648,3712,272). Two independently recreated sequential edge-toggle Morse matchings in increasing and decreasing pivot order have 20,408 and 20,435 pairs respectively, leave one 0-cell with (39 four-cells,168 five-cells) or (12 four-cells,141 five-cells), and reverse acyclic orientations on all 210,400 ordinary Hasse covers. Independent signed-gradient recursions (from the actual oriented simplex boundary, not logs) give 39x168 and 12x141 integer Morse matrices with 909 and 512 nonzero entries. Exact SymPy Smith normal forms yield 38 and 11 nonzero invariant factors, all equal to 1, giving H4=Z and H5=Z^130 with no torsion. With no cells in dimensions 1--3, homotopy classes of five-cell attachments to a wedge of S4 are classified by the integral degree matrix. Primitive Smith pivots split off contractible 4/5-cell pairs; the residual S4 and 130 S5 prove the full wedge statement.
residual_risks: The finite certificate exhausts one specified graph; no proof for all hypercubes or general periodic grids.
Two different matchings and a mod-two crosscheck corroborate, but the integral conclusion rests on the independently re-evaluated exact signed Smith forms.
